title: Rationalization of a prescribed integral section model
statement: Fix a finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime ell distinct from its characteristic, a finite coefficient field E with valuation ring R [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], a separated finite-type scheme X over the geometric field, and a compactification c. Let K_R be integral constructible [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] and K_E rational constructible [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], with localization of K_R isomorphic to K_E. For every small R-complex P, let I be Q of its coefficient/carrier lift and V=Q(E tensor_R P). If integral ordinary sections are isomorphic to I then rational ordinary sections of K_E are isomorphic to V. The identical implication holds for compact sections using c. Sections are precisely [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology]; this theorem makes no perfectness or boundedness assertion and constructs no model.

proof.text: Construct the natural tensor/carrier interchange using Mathlib TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.uliftEquiv. Its pure-tensor formula commutes with every module morphism, hence gives a chain isomorphism on P. The exact-functor derived-category factorization isomorphisms identify the two derived tensor presentations.

proof.text: Use the rational point normalization and pointFibreRationalDownIso to identify the lifted rational fibre with exact scalar extension of the integral fibre. Apply the given presentation and the tensor interchange. Reflect the resulting lifted derived isomorphism: carrier lift is fully faithful on modules; transport each cohomology isomorphism back, lift the family using field-complex cohomology splitting, and use cohomology detection of derived isomorphisms.

source.place: Step 3: integral models and exact rationalization

proof.text: For ordinary sections use the existing strict integral direct-image model. Its reconstruction compares the image functor with the ambient completed direct image. Map the completeness Roos triangle under that right-derived functor; preservation of products and the restriction comparison give the direct-image Roos triangle. Uniqueness identifies this vertex with integralImage. Extend the integral linear image functor to raw scalar localization, map the representative isomorphism, and conjugate with these comparisons.

source.place: Step 3: integral models and exact rationalization

proof.text: For compact sections map the representative isomorphism by sfCompactSupportFiniteFunctor. Its integral object normalization identifies its values with sfRationalCompactSupportValue. Apply the point-model comparison to the integral compact image, then compose the representative comparison. Pair the ordinary and compact implications.

theorem sections_rational_model_comparison
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (c : Compactification (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k)))
    (K_E : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X)
    (K_R : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X)
    (hrep : Nonempty ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K_R ≅ K_E))
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) ℤ) :
    let I := DerivedCategory.Q.{u + 1}.obj
      (((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
          (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) ≃+*
            Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E).toRingHom
        ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
    let V := DerivedCategory.Q.{u}.obj
      (((ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u}
        (algebraMap (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) E)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj P)
    (Nonempty ((integralOrdinarySections D l hl E X K_R).obj ≅ I) →
      Nonempty ((rationalOrdinarySections D l hl E X K_E).obj ≅ V)) ∧
    (Nonempty ((integralCompactSections D l hl E X c K_R).obj ≅ I) →
      Nonempty ((rationalCompactSections D l hl E X c K_E).obj ≅ V))
